subject.title: feat(gateway): wire read coding tool into HTTP /tools/invoke (narrow)

question: Should OpenClaw support owner/admin direct invocation of the built-in host-filesystem `read` tool behind `gateway.tools.allow`, `gateway.tools.directInvoke.hostFsRead`, and the existing per-request owner identity gate?
rationale: The code can enforce the proposed contract, but accepting authenticated host-file disclosure and a new public config surface is a security and product boundary decision that automation cannot make.

options.title: Accept the triple-gated capability
options.body: Approve the default-off owner-only read surface, its audit warning, plugin collision behavior, and documented upgrade contract, then refresh and land the branch.

options.title: Keep built-in coding tools agent-only
options.body: Do not add the config or built-in direct-invoke path; retain plugin tools as the customizable direct-invoke extension surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the triple-gated capability
recommendation.body: Approve the default-off owner-only read surface, its audit warning, plugin collision behavior, and documented upgrade contract, then refresh and land the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the touched security implementation and Gateway security documentation and is the best available route for the boundary decision.
